[SWS_DM_01101] Debouncing parameters from Monitor Constructor
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04068
⌈
If Debouncing parameters and methods are not present in DEXT, DM shall use the
Monitor Constructor values and Algorithm, as provided. In these instances, debounc-
ing relevant DEXT parameters in the following requirements shall be replaced by the
Monitor Constructor values.
⌋
7.3.4.1.5.1 Counter-based debouncing
Counter-based debouncing is done on a per
event
based counting policy of reported
kPrepassed
or
kPrefailed
from
diagnostic monitors
. Per event an internal
debounce counter is used. Passed or failed event states for events are calculated by
evaluating configured thresholds of the internal debounce counter.
